subject: Request: Storix evaluation — temporary credits/top-up
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena@storix.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 1 May 2026 09:12:23 -0700
Subject: Trial credit top-up request — Storix evaluation

Hi Tessa,

We hit our token cap during a demo yesterday and the evaluation has effectively paused — the team still needs to run a second integration test and a couple of end-to-end prompts to finish the POC. Our trial shows the account ID Storix-132 and it expires in 3 days.

Would Redwood consider a short, one-time top-up or a short extension (7–14 days) of promotional credits? We were relying on the initial $200 credit but usage spiked when we integrated streaming reads. If possible, a $400 top-up would let us complete the tests and decide on a Dedicated trial.

We can share a short summary of what we ran (attached) and a brief note about conversion timeline — we expect a procurement conversation by mid-May if the POC completes.

Thanks for considering,
Elena Rossi
Head of Platform
Storix AI

Attachments: evaluation_summary.pdf (1 page — test logs and sample prompts)

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@storix.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 1 May 2026 10:03:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Trial credit top-up request — Storix evaluation

Hi Elena — thanks for the note and the attached summary.

I can shepherd this through a quick discretionary approval if leadership signs off. Two clarifying Qs before I escalate:
- Is the $400 requested in total or would $250–300 already cover the remaining E2E tests?
- Do you expect any production traffic during this extension window (we want to avoid accidental charges on live traffic).

I’m looping in Monica (CS lead for PLG escalations) and Karthik (sales director) to confirm the approach. If approved we can issue a time-limited promo credit that applies automatically to the Storix account.

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive, Self-Serve Growth
Redwood Inference

Tessa / Karthik — reviewed the summary. Context: Storix is a mid-stage platform team, product/engineering-led evaluation with clear conversion timing (procurement mid-May). Recommended discretionary action:

- Approve a $400 promotional credit, applied for 14 days from issuance (grace window).
- Mark this as a self-serve promo (no committed Dedicated quota) and tag the HubSpot record with "promo-grace-may26".

Hi Elena — good news. Monica approved a one-time promotional credit. Details below and next steps: 

What we issued:
- $400 promo credit applied to Storix-132
- Valid for 14 days from 2026-05-01 (expires 2026-05-15 23:59 PDT)
- One-time, non-recurring; will not convert into committed capacity

How it works:
- Credit is applied automatically at billing; nothing for your team to redeem.
- We’ve enabled a short usage cap to prevent accidental production consumption during the window. If you anticipate any traffic > 5k tokens/min, let me know and we’ll adjust.

Next steps for Storix:
1) Confirm that $400 is sufficient for your remaining tests or advise if you need it split across teams.
2) If POC completes, please schedule a 30-min sync with Karthik to map out Dedicated timing and procurement expectations (link to calendar: https://cal.redwood.ai/karthik/30).
3) Reply to this thread to confirm you received the credit and we’ll close the support case.

Attachments: promo_instructions.pdf (one-page with control panel screenshots and expiry details)

Thanks — good luck completing the E2E tests. Monica, I logged the promo in the admin portal and added the HubSpot tag per your note.
